correctness.rationale: Using normalized area, the Gram matrix on 1, x_1, x_2 is diag(1,s,s) with s=(2+cos(2pi/n))/12. Strict opposite signs of two vertex kernel rows occur on a common positive-measure set, forcing strict convexity on all nonvertex convex combinations. The cap area B and first moment M are obtained by explicit shoelace identities; the norm is 1-2(B+M/s)/A. The missing-layer polar expansion and parameter variation produce 5*pi*sqrt(15)/12. Independent piecewise-polynomial triangle integrations corroborate 78 values (n=3..80) to <1.4e-15; numerical tests cannot prove the infinite assertion.

value.rationale: The induced L-infinity norm of an orthogonal affine least-squares projector controls endpoint stability, near-best uniform approximation and the precise positivity defect. The complete family of regular n-gons is the canonical convex polygonal approximation to the disk. Exact full-order norms, vertex rigidity, and the nonzero quadratic geometry-defect coefficient are motivated, reusable quantities, not an arbitrary finite table or a simple restatement of the disk constant.
